parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) The student suspends a load L = 1.00 N from the spring. He records the new length l of the spring in Table 1.1. He calculates the extension e of the spring using the equation e = ( l – l 0 ) and records the value of e in Table 1.1. The student repeats the procedure using loads L = 2.00 N, 3.00 N, 4.00 N and 5.00 N. The readings and results are recorded in Table 1.1. Calculate the extension e of the spring using the equation e = ( l – l 0 ) when L = 5.00 N. Record this value of e in Table 1.1.
